items.name: 普洱
items.description: Earthy and robust, almost impossible to over-steep — gets better the longer it sits.
items.pairs: Dried tangerine zest, dried ginger, dried orange zest.

items.name: Roasted corn tea
items.description: Nutty and slightly sweet, a Korean and Chinese staple.
items.pairs: Cinnamon, dried ginger, barley tea as a blend.

items.name: Soba (buckwheat) tea
items.description: Toasty, nutty, and slightly savoury. Popular in Japan and Korea.
items.pairs: Barley tea as a blend, dried ginger, citrus zest.

items.name: Masala chai
items.description: A full spiced black tea — robust black tea base steeped with whole spices. Bolder and richer than cinnamon bark alone. The definitive warming drink.
items.pairs: Cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, star anise, cloves, dried orange zest, fresh ginger.
notes: No milk in the flask if carrying it for a long time — add milk fresh to the cup instead.

items.name: Turmeric & ginger (golden milk style)
items.description: Warming and anti-inflammatory. Use ground turmeric and ginger directly in the flask with hot water or a milk alternative.
items.pairs: Black pepper (enhances turmeric absorption), cinnamon, honey in the cup.

items.name: Hot alcoholic cider
items.description: Warm spiced apple cider — sweeter and lighter than Glühwein, with a rich caramelised apple flavour that deepens beautifully in the flask.

items.name: Mulled mead
items.description: Honey wine warmed with spices — sweeter and more floral than Glühwein. Worth hunting down in Joburg.

items.name: Irish coffee
items.description: Strong hot brew coffee with Irish whiskey and brown sugar. No milk — it'll curdle in the flask. The whiskey and coffee deepen nicely together over time.

items.name: Hot toddy
items.description: Whiskey, hot water, honey, lemon peel and a cinnamon stick. Simple, satisfying, and a classic cold weather flask drink.

items.name: Spiced dark rum
items.description: Dark rum warmed with hot water, cinnamon, cloves and dried orange zest. Easy to make and very warming.

items.name: Mulled port
items.description: Port wine warmed with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange zest. Richer and sweeter than Glühwein, almost dessert-like. Best for a shorter flask session as it's quite intense.
